# Original 0.4.84 offline test sources

These exact files were copied from the registered controller identified in manifest.json.
Tests verify byte counts and SHA256 before reading them. These reader, parser and journal
checks use explicit process/RPC fixtures and do not prove live delivery or model execution.
This subset cannot be installed or used as a runtime. Full materialization tests still
require the original complete local controller and client packages. Historical controller
registrations and attempts are unchanged.
